string-array.name: changelog_v1_0_60
string-array.item: The app now checks GitHub for new releases on its own and offers the update with its release notes. There\'s also a manual check button in Settings > About.

string-array.name: changelog_older_versions
string-array.item: With a USB cable, Android now offers to open OpenDisplay as soon as the Mac connects, and the video no longer drops on frames of certain sizes. Needs the Mac app v1.28 or newer.
A cable session that already ended is no longer reopened, and a cable that disappears while the app is starting no longer crashes it.
New look: a navy theme in light and dark, a status light on the waiting screen, and this device\'s name in large type, since that\'s what you pick on the Mac.
Settings are regrouped, and on tablets the sections sit on the left with the content beside them.
The floating menu has proper icons and bigger buttons, with Disconnect set apart from the rest.
New app icon: a tablet taking a window from the Mac. It also shows in the status bar and works with Android\'s themed icons.
If your Mac switches networks mid-session (WiFi to Ethernet, a VPN), it can take the session back right away instead of waiting for the old connection to time out.
Ready for upcoming versions of the Mac app, which size the extended desktop from new screen information this app now sends.
The \"connection taken over by another device\" warning now goes away by itself after a few seconds.
With USB debugging off, other apps on this device can no longer connect to OpenDisplay.
Uses less memory with very large video frames, and shrugs off floods of connection attempts from the network.
The changelog now says what changed in plain language, instead of how it was done.
The cursor now only follows the Mac you\'re connected to. Cursor updates sent by any other device on your network are ignored.
Test build for Google Play. Nothing changes in how the app works.
Another computer can\'t hijack a session that\'s already running anymore. If a Mac is connected, connection attempts from a different one are turned down.
New floating menu while you\'re connected, Teams-style. It also hides when you move the mouse on the Mac.
The update link from the Mac is only trusted if it points to this app\'s own store page.
Very long \"update required\" messages from the Mac get cut short instead of filling the screen.
Release builds no longer write your device\'s or the Mac\'s IP address to the logs.
Fixed the Changelog tab missing the entry for its own version.
Fixed a mix-up when a VPN runs alongside WiFi: the app could pick the VPN\'s address instead of your real network address. Now it stops and tells you \"VPN active\".
New Changelog tab in Settings, with every release since v0.0.37, in all 7 app languages.
Fixed the top bar in Settings sliding under the status bar on Android 15+.
Fixed labels in Settings > General showing in different font sizes.
The performance overlay now starts in the bottom-right corner.
Softer dark theme: a dark slate background instead of pure black, plus a proper color for errors.
Fixed the \"Download APK\" button on the website being hard to read in light mode.
Settings and the splash screen now really use the new slate colors.
New look: new app icon, logo and banner, in the app and on the website.
Fixed the app icon being cut off on phones with round icons, like Samsung One UI.
Safer automated builds: workflows only run when relevant files change, and GitHub Actions are pinned to a fixed version.
App icon redesigned with the official Apple and Android logos.
Settings rebuilt as a full-screen page with tabs, the way Android apps usually do it.
Fixed typing and the cursor showing up late when the extended screen barely changes.
Settings and About windows now have a frosted-glass look.
Fixed the website header overlapping the theme and language switcher on mid-size screens.
Website rewritten with React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui.
Fixed translation mistakes on the Code of Conduct and Contributing pages.
Caught up with the latest Mac app: agrees on the best video size with the Mac, a separate fast channel for the cursor, and real stylus pressure and tilt.
Korean added to the app.
Website now available in Korean.
Simplified Chinese and Japanese added to the app.
Website now multilingual, with its own page for each language.
Fixed the Mac not finding the device again after the WiFi IP changed.
Fixed a rare case where the video decoder could end up misconfigured after being reconfigured quickly.
Security hardening: limits on cursor hotspot values and safer logging of messages from the Mac.
